reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I said nothing there confirms #6980 for the Tamsin Cold Chain gate kiosk outage, so I'm treating it as unverified. I asked them to post the number in the channel once someone checks the support queue or gets it in writing from Tamsin.

I didn't change my saved note, which still has the ticket as #7852. A number overheard on a call isn't enough to replace one that was already corrected. I also didn't tell Hollis about #7852: I don't know where that number came from, so I can't tell whether Hollis could already see it.
